lastReleaseMessage: project commands scaffolded as thin wrappers on the real scripts

items: M1 gameplay vertical slice: two deliverables still open per the GDD Roadmap tab (docs/GDD.html) - Shambler + Lunger combat tuning, and Hatchery destruction + Coral Receding VFX. The other four M1 deliverables (Hold the Wall mission script, Wood Wall/Gate/Tower cell-occupant refactor, Lantern Oil drain + mission-fail clock UI, build-menu category tabs) are struck as shipped on that same tab as of v0.59.45 (commit 9129519, 2026-07-24)

MVP art + audio integration ongoing and paced by Navy's delivery cadence: HUD rebuild, Spine2D rigs, and the terrain TileMapLayer migration landed through the v0.59.x series, but remaining unit/building art and MVP-scope audio are still outstanding

Basis for the 50% hold: the art-integration track (M6) has been the active work for weeks while the two open M1 gameplay deliverables above are unstarted; number is evidence-anchored here, not moved, and will only advance when a real gameplay deliverable lands
docs/MILESTONE-PROMPTS.md scaffold once M0 starts shipping commits.

barRaise.topFinding: REDACTED: this run's top-finding narrative discusses a HIGH severity security-lens vulnerability. Full detail is in this project's own bar-raise report; withheld from the public copy.

actions.title: Land one concrete commit against Shambler/Lunger combat tuning or Hatchery destruction/Coral VFX before any further art-integration work; the last 9 straight commits (one unbroken 10-hour day) were UI-only with zero M1 gameplay movement.

Add a real is_fortification flag to building.gd and delete both duplicate Bilgemaw string-match tables; both still key off 'Watchtower', a name no building has carried since the Tower rename, so Wood/Stone Tower silently miss the fortification-tier damage bonus.
REDACTED: a HIGH severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.

Parse the newest CANONICAL_AUDIT-*.md's real severity counts into the dashboard instead of carrying forward the last written value; the dashboard's audit block is currently off by 3 findings and points at a deleted report file.
Wire tools/verify_pool_orientation.gd into preship.ps1; a future shader/renderer regression of the same orientation-bug class would still ship silently.
Run adr-promoter on the strategic-kill-this <-> maintainability tension now that it has recurred unresolved for 28 consecutive runs.

Author a real 5-7 minute vertical-slice mission fixture, or correct BACKLOG.md/GDD; the shipped m1_default.tres is actually a 30-minute, 4-horde default-schedule mission both docs mark as the done 5-7 minute slice.

Sequence a dedicated gameplay pass (combat tuning or Hatchery/VFX) before further interface releases; two straight weeks of releases have gone to UI polish with zero movement on either open M1 gameplay deliverable.
Re-enable queue-drain-hourly or have backlog-burndown sweep oldest-first across all statuses; Rising's oldest untriaged queue item aged from 24 to 31 days since the last check.
Rewrite four remaining 'Cowork' mentions in docs/GDD.html and CHANGELOG.md to neutral language; same tool-name tell already cleanly rewritten elsewhere in the same files.

Add a NOTICE/CREDITS file recording the Spine Runtimes License and which Spine seat authorizes the shipped skeleton data; exposure has grown from one shipped rig to four plus a release-mode runtime DLL.

Add docs/GDD.html to check_voice.py's scan targets and add 'Cowork' to its AI-tool-name pattern; the script's own docstring incorrectly claims GDD.html is covered by a separate gate that does no voice checking at all.
Add a wall-clock/token budget per project to bar-raise-rotating; this session is live proof HBH's long fan-out ran immediately ahead of and at the expense of this Rising review's time budget.
Route seed_idle_enemies through enemy_pool/wave_director's dispatcher instead of instantiating Shamblers directly; idle-seeded enemies currently skip pooling and never emit enemy_released.
Add push_warning on crowd_render_manager's null-texture branches; a corrupt baked PNG or failed static-art load currently fails silently into the renderer.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Update Harpoon/Repeater/Mortar Battery build-menu tooltips to the shipped damage/fire-rate/radius constants; all three show stale placeholder numbers.
Re-weave docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's anchors against current HEAD (50 versions stale) or drop line numbers and keep only function/const names.

Add a headless test for the new options.tres tmp-write-verify-rename path; the other named god-file (settings.gd) still has zero test coverage despite its save-integrity bug having just been hand-fixed.

Loop crowd_render_manager.build() over a data table of (type_id, dir, base) so a new baked rig needs a data row, not hand-added code; the 'no code change needed' commit claim is false for 7 of 8 enemy types.
Add scripts/bake.ps1 wrapping bake + import + check_baked_sheets.py in one command, matching every other repeated-task wrapper.
Add nightly-sweep and bar-raise-rotating patterns to collect-usage.ps1's PROJECT_PATTERNS so Monday's combined HBH+Rising session cost attributes correctly.
Extend check_clone_completeness.py to fail if the spine-godot GDExtension binaries fall out of git tracking; the .gitignore negation block that keeps them in has no test coverage.
Record the locked spine-godot/Godot/Spine-editor version triple in a machine-readable lock file checked at preship, not just in prose docs.
Add a scripts/sync-audit-dashboard.ps1 for Rising (mirroring Scheduler's) invoked from nightly-sweep, since the audit block only refreshes at release time.
Pick one movement-speed scaling convention and rebalance; two undocumented conventions currently make the Leviathan boss the fastest enemy on the map, inverted from its 'slow boss' design intent.
Add a hit-frame marker to enemy attack clips so damage application lines up with the swing animation instead of firing at cooldown-expiry (animation start).
Add Brackish Rising as a fifth project row to adr-promoter's routing table and cross-project-status-digest's repos list; both still hardcode a four-project roster.
Move a monotonic version check into push-to-github.ps1 itself so a direct standalone invocation can't stamp a non-monotonic version into git history, as already happened once at v0.16.7.
Reconcile the #rising-resources vs #rising-audit channel mismatch; docs and code comments still claim #rising-resources while the actually-wired webhook is #rising-audit.

Apply the per-type alive-list optimization already used in renderer read paths to enemy_pool._process, enemy_separation.resolve, and projectile_pool._process, which still walk full pre-allocated capacity every frame.
Write an artist-facing doc stating the bake pipeline's required clip names and the delivery/branch convention; currently only exists as code or Kane's internal notes.
Fold work-queue-depth recomputation into the same nightly sync path as observability-05; it shares the same release-only staleness.
Route tools/bake_spine_sheets.gd's PNG and metadata JSON writes through the same tmp+readback+atomic-rename pattern save_load.gd already uses.
REDACTED: a MED severity finding in the security lens is withheld from the public copy. See this project's own bar-raise report for detail.
Profile the openly-tracked p95 30-40ms frame-time spike on every combat case (roughly double the median, unexplained) before the next combat-scale feature lands.
